verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Qaaf wal-qur'aanil-majeed
Bal ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirun minhum faqaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa shay'un ajeeb
A'idhaa mitnaa wa kunnaa turaaban dhaalika raj'un ba'eed
Qad alimnaa maa tanqusul-ardu minhum wa indanaa kitaabun hafeez
Bal kadhdhaboo bil-haqqi lammaa jaa'ahum fahum fee amrin mareej
Afalam yanzuroo ilas-samaa'i fawqahum kayfa banaynaahaa wa zayyannaahaa wa maa lahaa min furooj
Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa anbatnaa feehaa min kulli zawjin baheej
Tabsiratan wa dhikraa likulli abdin muneeb
Wa nazzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an mubaarakan fa-anbatnaa bihi jannaatin wa habbal-haseed
Wan-nakhla baasiqaatin lahaa tal'un nadeed
Rizqan lil-ibaadi wa ahyaynaa bihi baldatan maytan kadhaalikal-khurooj
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa ashaabur-rassi wa thamood
Wa aadun wa fir'awnu wa ikhwaanu loot
Wa ashaabul-aykati wa qawmu tubba'in kullun kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa wa-eed
Afa'ayeenaa bil-khalqil-awwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeed
Wa laqad khalaqnal-insaana wa na'lamu maa tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wa nahnu aqrabu ilayhi min hablil-wareed
Idh yatalaqqal-mutalaqqiyaani anil-yameeni wa anish-shimaali qa'eed
Maa yalfizu min qawlin illaa ladayhi raqeebun ateed
Wa jaa'at sakratul-mawti bil-haqqi dhaalika maa kunta minhu taheed
Wa nufikha fis-soori dhaalika yawmul-wa-eed
Wa jaa'at kullu nafsin ma'ahaa saa'iqun wa shaheed
Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min haadhaa fakashafnaa anka ghitaa'aka fabasarukal-yawma hadeed
Wa qaala qareenuhu haadhaa maa ladayya ateed
Alqiyaa fee jahannama kulla kaffaarin aneed
Mannaa'in lilkhayri mu'tadin mureeb
Al-ladhee ja'ala ma'a Allaahi ilahan aakhara fa-alqiyaahu fil-adhaabish-shadeed
Qaala qareenuhu rabbanaa maa atghaytuhu wa laakin kaana fee dalaalin ba'eed
Qaala laa takhtasimoo ladayya wa qad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-wa-eed
Maa yubaddalul-qawlu ladayya wa maa anaa bizallaamin lil-abeed
Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hal imtala'ti wa taqoolu hal min mazeed
Wa uzlifatil-jannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra ba'eed
Haadhaa maa too'adoona likulli awwaabin hafeez
Man khashiyar-Rahmaana bil-ghaybi wa jaa'a biqalbin muneeb
Udkhuloohaa bisalaamin dhaalika yawmul-khulood
Lahum maa yashaa'oona feehaa wa ladaynaa mazeed
Wa kam ahlaknaa qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fil-bilaadi hal min mahees
Inna fee dhaalika ladhikraa liman kaana lahu qalbun aw alqas-sam'a wa huwa shaheed
Wa laqad khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin wa maa massanaa min lughoob
Fasbir alaa maa yaqooloona wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tuloo'ish-shamsi wa qablal-ghuroob
Wa minal-layli fasabbihhu wa adbaaras-sujood
Wastami yawma yunaadil-munaadi min makaanin qareeb
Yawma yasma'oonas-sayhata bil-haqqi dhaalika yawmul-khurooj
Innaa nahnu nuhyee wa numeetu wa ilaynal-maseer
Yawma tashaqqaqul-ardu anhum siraa'an dhaalika hashrun alaynaa yaseer
Nahnu a'lamu bimaa yaqooloona wa maa anta alayhim bijabbaarin fadhakkir bil-qur'aani man yakhaafu wa-eed
